description: Every ring statement and its public input HashChain4(elements). The transfer head is [CRTX, n0, ring_id, pack_be(0x04 || tx_u), pack_be(auditor_pubkey), pack_be(0x04 || eph_u), digest(envelope), salt, layout] with the frame's random salt and layout = key_escrow << 1 | full_openings << 3. digest(ct) = Poseidon(u32 len(ct), HashChain4(pack_left31(ct))). Each envelope has the length of its stream layout, the delivered slots carry the body and the anonymous and exit slots the record the auditor message carries. The deposit statement is HashChain(elements) over CRDP, the context hash of the program id, tree and SPP data, the count, the anonymous flag, each owner hash with its capsule ciphertext hash zero padded to 8 slots, both tagged keys packed, the escrow flag, the registry root, the curator root, the policy hash and each asset hash with its amount zero padded to 8 slots. The transfer statements are version 3, HashChain4 over the audit head under CRTX. The confidential family then holds in_proof, delegate, exempt, approval_required, output_count, output_chain, output_ciphertext_chain HashChain4(hash_bytes(ct_i)), recipient_key_chain, input_count, exits_bitmap, private_tx_hash, sender, signer_count, signer_chain, policy_hash, own_root, curator_root, one recipient per capacity slot, asset, net and gross per public slot, withdrawal_hash, the element count and the version. The anonymous family holds exempt, approval_required, output_count, output_chain, output_ciphertext_chain, recipient_body_chain HashChain4(hash_bytes(body_i)), recipient_tag_chain, HashChain4 of the tag of each body-bearing slot, zero elsewhere, zero filled to the capacity, then the bundle tag, change_bitmap, digest(sender bundle), input_count, exits_bitmap, private_tx_hash, the three party identities, signer_count, signer_chain, policy_hash, own_root, curator_root, the public slots, withdrawal_hash, digest(replies) or zero, the element count and the version. Every per-slot chain is zero filled to the capacity. signer_chain is HashChain4 over the deduplicated owner identities zero filled to the key's S, and zero when signer_count is zero on every rail. Produced by program-libs/interface/tests/statements.rs.
